JOIN OUR PYTHON DEVELOPMENT TEAM @ LEVI9 IASI
 At Levi9 we are passionate about what we do. We love our work and together in a team, we are smarter and stronger. We are looking for skilled team players who make change happen. Are you one of these players? Join the magic number at levi9.ro.
 PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
 As far as projects go, from fintech to transport solutions, we work together with the world's top companies.
You will join a skilled engineering community focused on building reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions, while collaborating closely with colleagues and customer teams.
There is no bigger prize than a customer leading his market thanks to our solutions.
 THE ROLE INVOLVES:
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality backend applications and services using Python and its ecosystem.
Build scalable, secure, and high-performance systems, including APIs, microservices, distributed applications, and data-intensive services.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into robust technical solutions.
Contribute to technical design and architecture decisions, with a focus on maintainability, security, and long-term value.
Write clean, testable code and contribute to automated testing, code reviews, and engineering quality practices.
Troubleshoot and optimize applications and production systems for reliability, availability, and performance.
Share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and support the professional growth of other engineers.
Contribute to continuous improvement by promoting engineering standards, automation, and effective delivery practices.
Use AI-assisted engineering practices where appropriate to support design, implementation, debugging, code review, testing, documentation, research, and task breakdown.
Critically review and validate solutions, including AI-generated output, against requirements, edge cases, security standards, and engineering best practices, while maintaining ownership of the final result.
 TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on Python and backend development.
Strong proficiency in Python and solid knowledge of its ecosystem, including dependency management, packaging, common development practices and specific frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, microservices, or distributed systems.
Experience with asynchronous programming, event-driven systems, or background processing.
Experience with SQL and relational databases; exposure to NoSQL technologies is an advantage.
Experience with automated testing tools together with a strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and performance.
Hands-on experience with Git and modern collaborative software development practices.
Practical experience with at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS or Azure, including working with cloud-based services, application deployments, and production environments.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, using tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized applications using Docker.
Practical experience using AI-powered development tools in software engineering workflows, together with the judgment to apply them responsibly and effectively.
 NICE TO HAVE:
Experience with Kafka, messaging systems, or event-driven architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, or other container orchestration technologies.
Experience with data processing libraries or platforms and building data-intensive applications.
Experience with Elasticsearch, Elastic Stack, or similar search and analytics technologies.
Experience supporting or optimizing production systems for high availability and performance.
Experience integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into software products or internal engineering solutions.
Relevant cloud or Python certifications and contributions to technical communities or open-source projects.
 SOFT SKILLS:
Fluent English, with good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with colleagues and customer teams.
Proactive, result-driven, and comfortable taking ownership.
Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback.
Curious and willing to learn and adapt across different technologies, domains, and project contexts, including emerging tools and AI-assisted ways of working.
 WHAT WE HOPE YOU MIGHT ENJOY:
Great colleagues, tech, and fun-oriented place to work
Personal and technical development through courses, training, conferences, and certifications under the Levi9 Academy umbrella
Udemy for business
A good book with Bookster
Parenting sessions if needed
Team buildings (with the company, your project, or your department)
Fun activities with colleagues sharing your passion (Ex: CSR campaigns, Movie Nights, Football, etc.)
21 annual vacation days + 1 extra day every two years
Floating holidays
Meal tickets
Medical subscription
Vacation bonus
Hybrid way of working
Unlimited access to Levi9 gym
